title: Second-order Taylor bound along a segment from the origin
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R, S ∈ ℝ, let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) be C² on the open ball B̆_R(0) (ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h (ball 0 R)), and let v ∈ ℝⁿ with ‖v‖ < R. Suppose |D²h(τv)(v, v)| ≤ S for every τ ∈ [0, 1], where D²h(y)(a, b) := iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![a, b]. Then |h(v) − h(0) − Dh(0)v| ≤ S/2, where Dh = fderiv ℝ h.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (R S : ℝ) (v : Euclid n), ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ‖v‖ < R → (∀ τ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h (τ • v) ![v, v]| ≤ S) → |h v - h 0 - fderiv ℝ h 0 v| ≤ S / 2
